(2) The scene cuts between the reactors and the music video; the men laugh and use dynamic hand motions, including pointing and waving, to emphasize their points. (4) The split-screen remains, showing the female singer's dramatic performance while the reactors continue their comedic analysis with high energy and constant movement.
